transcript.description: A verbatim transcript of the words spoken or sung in the video.

spoken_language.description: The primary language spoken or sung in the video — if several are used, give the one used most. Provide an English name (e.g. 'English', 'Mandarin', 'Arabic'). Use '-' if there is no spoken or sung language (music-only or silent).

multilingual.description: Are multiple languages spoken or sung in the video (e.g. code-switching, or different speakers using different languages)? Answer No if there is no speech or only one language is used.

objects.description: Notable objects visible in the video.

age_estimate.description: the apparent age of the face, in years (a single best estimate)

faces.description: Each distinct face that appears in the video, with its gender, apparent age in years, and apparent ethnicity.

speech_vs_music.description: the percentage of the audio that is spoken word (0 = all music/other, 100 = all speech)

background_music.description: the style or mood of any background music

audio_summary.description: The video's audio profile: how much of the audio is speech (as a percentage of speech vs music/other), the style/mood of any background music, and any notable sounds or sound effects.

main_activity.description: The main activity, as a verb + object, e.g. 'dancing in a studio'.

video_story.description: A concise narrative summary of the entire video.

type_of_story.description: The narrative type of the video.

content_category.description: The TikTok content categories that best capture the video's dominant focus (up to two; list the most central first). Weigh whether the video's primary purpose is entertainment & cultural expression, lifestyle & personal content, or informative & advisory content, then choose the most fitting category.

primary_country.description: The country the video is primarily connected to — through the creator's origin (accent, language, location tags, or profile), the content's subject matter (events, places, landmarks, or social issues), or its intended audience (region-specific hashtags or localised references). Give the single most-connected country as an English name (e.g. 'Australia', 'United States', 'India'). Use '-' when there is no clear country connection (generic or globally-oriented content).

tiktok_native.description: Is the video produced primarily for TikTok — vertical/portrait, short (typically under 60 seconds), using TikTok's native features (filters, effects, text overlays, trending sounds) and pacing? Answer No for content clearly made for another platform (e.g. a longer YouTube or TV-style video) and merely reposted to TikTok.

trend_technical.description: Does the video leverage a technical TikTok trend — a trending template, effect, or sound used to make it (e.g. a CapCut 'try this effect' or 'use this sound' template)? A video can be both a technical and a cultural trend.

trend_cultural.description: Does the video replicate a cultural TikTok trend — a participatory format meant for other creators to imitate (e.g. a dance challenge, meme, or format like 'candy salad')? A video can be both a technical and a cultural trend.

advertising.description: Is the video an explicit paid promotion of a product, service, or brand — shown by a sponsorship label, repeated prominent brand mentions, or a direct call to purchase or visit? Answer No for an organic review or discussion, or a creator simply expressing affinity for a brand with no sign of a commercial agreement.

aigc.description: Is the video primarily AI-generated — AI-generated elements forming a substantial part of it (e.g. prompt-generated footage), or explicitly labelled AI-generated by the creator or platform? Answer No when only minor AI elements are present (e.g. AI stickers, memes, or background music).

main_gender.description: The gender of the main person featured in the video.

main_ethnicity.description: The ethnicity of the main person featured in the video.

political_score.description: How political the video is, from 0 (not at all) to 100 (entirely political).

sensitivity_score.description: How sensitive the video's subject matter is, from 0 (not at all) to 100 (extremely sensitive).

call_to_action.description: The action the video encourages the viewer to take, or '-' if none.
